_help: EDIT THIS FILE to change the update announcement - no recompiling needed. The announcement shows once per save, and again every time the mod's version number changes (the Version in manifest.json). Type is 'heading' or 'text'. {farmerName} is replaced by the player's name. Use plain ASCII punctuation only (no long dashes or curly quotes); Stardew's fonts do not all have them.

Blocks.Text: Welcome, {farmerName}!
Thank you for downloading Bentley's Fast Food! Here is everything you can do.
The Restaurant
Bentley's restaurant is on the Bus Stop map and is open 24 hours a day, every day. Tap or click the front door to go in.
Sit on any chair or booth: tap, click or press the action button on it.
Ordering Counter Menu
Cheeseburger (180g): a big filling meal.
French Fries (90g): a small snack.
Chicken Nuggets (140g): a medium meal, sold only here.
Coke (100g): a drink that gives Speed +1 for a while.
Milkshake (180g): a drink that gives Defense +1 and Speed +1. Sold only at Bentley's counter, not at Gus's. Bentley also teaches you the recipe at 4 hearts, so you can cook it yourself.
Farmhand Snack Pack (220g): gives Farming +1 and Mining +1 for a long time.
Windex (25g): a joke item. It hurts you and makes you dizzy (Speed -1, Luck -1). Please do not drink real window cleaner!

Bentley runs the counter from 6 AM to 6 PM. The Restaurant Robot runs it the rest of the time. Gus's Saloon only sells the Cheeseburger, French Fries, Coke, Snack Pack and Windex. Chicken Nuggets, the Milkshake and all the desserts are only at Bentley's.
Dessert Corner (left room)

Talk to the kiosk from the pink mat. Ice Cream Sundae (200g), Soft Serve Cone (140g, Speed +1), Fudge Brownie (160g), Strawberry Cheesecake (220g, Defense +1), Glazed Donut (120g), Banana Split (260g, Luck +1) and the Windex Swirl Cone (60g, it hurts). Gus's does not sell any desserts. Only Bentley's has them.
Arcade (right room)
Play Journey of the Prairie King and Junimo Kart.
Bentley's Day
6:10 AM: Bentley is behind the counter.
6:00 PM: he walks to Gus's Saloon.
11:30 PM: he goes home to his bedroom to sleep.
The Restaurant Robot is in the bedroom until 7 PM, then works the counter all night.
Bentley's birthday is Spring 11. He loves burgers, fries, nuggets, milkshakes and desserts. He does not like Windex.
Staff Door
Stand in front of the double door behind the kitchen and tap or click it to visit Bentley's bedroom. It is open to everyone.
Settings

Code/config.json lets you change how much health Windex (WindexDrinkDamage) and the Windex Swirl Cone (WindexSwirlConeDamage) take. Set to 0 for none. Copy your old config into the new Code folder when updating.
Compatibility
This mod should be compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded.
Any mod that changes the Bus Stop area may mess with this mod. If the restaurant looks wrong, try removing the other Bus Stop mod.
Thank you!
Creator: Bentley Playz
